issues.description: Radar chart with 6 dimensions (Warmth, Complexity, Organic, Layered, Heritage, Character) is completely absent from the screen
issues.root_cause: The radar chart component is either not imported/rendered in apps/web/app/design/step-4/page.tsx, or it fails silently due to a missing dependency or hydration error causing the chart to not render

issues.description: Multiple hydration errors on page (Text content does not match server-rendered HTML, entire root switching to client rendering). Also auth/page.tsx has duplicate useEffect and useState imports causing build errors.
issues.root_cause: apps/web/app/auth/page.tsx has two import statements importing useEffect and useState from react — one at line 2 (`import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'`) and another at line 5 (`import { FormEvent, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'`). This causes a build error.

issues.description: Tweak input field is missing from the fingerprint reveal screen
issues.root_cause: The tweak/refinement input field is not rendered in apps/web/app/design/step-4/page.tsx — it may have been omitted during implementation

fixes.new_str:
import { Cormorant_Garamond, Manrope } from "next/font/google";

fixes.reason: Remove the duplicate first import line that re-declares useEffect and useState, keeping only the more complete second import that also includes FormEvent and useMemo
